## Text columns keep their surrounding space {#text-column-spacing}

A shared question stays separate from the two groups below.

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}
### First group

- A first point.
- Another point.
:::
::: {.column width="70%"}
### Second group

A longer explanation belongs to the second group and can wrap independently.

This paragraph adds detail within the same group.
:::
::::

This paragraph starts below both columns.

## Prose and tables have room to read {#prose-table-spacing}

The first paragraph introduces the comparison.

The next paragraph develops the same question.

### A separate part of the argument

| Group | Estimate | Interval |
|:------|---------:|:---------|
| First | 0.18 | 0.10–0.26 |
| Second | 0.12 | 0.04–0.20 |

## Smaller body, stable headings {#smaller-heading-sizing .smaller}

```{=html}
<h1>Level-one content heading</h1>
```

### Level-three content heading

Only the body text should become smaller.

## Tables leave room for handout notes {#handout-table-spacing}

| Measure | Definition |
|:--------|:-----------|
| Prior score | Recorded before eligibility was assigned.<br>Standardized within each application round. |
| Completed courses | Courses passed during the first two terms.<br>Counted using a common registration window. |
| Study time | Weekly hours reported before the offer.<br>Grouped using the same baseline questionnaire. |
| Travel distance | Distance from the recorded home to campus.<br>Measured before the start of the first term. |

Every measure uses the same synthetic sample.

::: {.aside}
Source: synthetic records prepared for the layout fixture.<br>
Definitions remain visible in both delivery modes.
:::

::: notes
Introduce the measures before discussing estimates.<br>
Explain that the score predates the eligibility decision.<br>
Keep the course registration window consistent across groups.<br>
Distinguish reported study time from observed course completion.<br>
Remind readers that these records are entirely synthetic.
:::

## Canvas and decorative content {#canvas-content}

```{=html}
<span id="decorative-mark" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
<canvas id="sample-chart" width="100" height="50" role="img" aria-label="A solid burgundy rectangle"></canvas>
<script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => { const context = document.getElementById("sample-chart").getContext("2d"); context.fillStyle = "#62273b"; context.fillRect(0, 0, 100, 50); });</script>
```
